The official code with opacity_reset_interval=3000 also enables size_threshold=20 (train.py:219). The plugin reproduces both behaviours (density.py:157-158, 201-204) only when the config is set.

issues.problem: The extra-update count is wrong: densification iterations are steps 600..14900 every 100, which is 144, not 145. With GS8 the reset iterations (3000/6000/9000/12000) also coincide; there the official code skips the opacity update because the parameter is replaced before the step, while the plugin updates first and then resets.
issues.evidence: train.py:213-243: densify/reset run before optimizer.step, and replaced nn.Parameters have grad=None, so the kernel skips them.
issues.fix: Correct the count to 144 and mention the reset-iteration case in the fidelity gap.

issues.problem: The visibility set differs from diff-gauss and this is not listed as a fidelity gap. gsplat 1.5.3 projection sets radii=0 for opacity < 1/255 and uses opacity-aware tighter radii; it also uses near_plane 0.01 vs 3DGS 0.2. Near-dead primitives are therefore invisible here: they get no Sparse-Adam/DAR update and no asystep increment, while in the official code they are visible. Tighter radii also lower max_radii for the GS8 20-px prune.
issues.evidence: gsplat cuda/csrc/ProjectionEWA3DGSFused.cu:171-178 (ALPHA_THRESHOLD cull, extend = sqrt(2 log(o/ALPHA_THRESHOLD))); official visibility_filter = radii>0 from diff-gauss.
issues.fix: Record this as a fidelity gap. The effect is expected to be small because o<0.005 is pruned every 100 iterations until 15k.

issues.problem: No probe would fail if AdamWGSDensity.initialize stopped installing SparseAdamWGS into the runtime's optimizers dict. sparse_step constructs the optimizer directly, and rsr/topology pass with plain Adam. probe_assessment.why: Independent scalar adam.cu transcription. Checks that invisible rows and moments are bit-identical and that a global-step reference is distinguishable. The unit test with dense update fails it.
Window edges 2999/3000/15000/15001 and 999/1000. Moments must equal the pure photometric EMA, and the cap step is exactly lr*10. The no-DAR monkeypatch fails it.
Compares against an independent digits formula on four sizes.
Exact row count int(ratio*N) per milestone and identical rows across all fields, scaled by a1/a2.
Checks asystep inheritance order, zero child moments, and opacity correction on source and clone, then check_state.
Compares against gsplat inject_noise_to_position (same formula as the official train.py) with the same RNG seed, plus the schedule.
No probe asserts that the runtime's optimizers become SparseAdamWGS. Verified manually by the reviewer.

fidelity_gaps_confirmed: Runtime-wide: white background, random-with-replacement views, SSIM valid conv, SH degree and means LR one step late.
Optimizer step before densification: 144 (not 145) extra updates; GS8 also gets opacity updates on reset iterations.
alpha2 = 0.01, the value the released code actually uses (it reads the misspelled key rsr_exeabg_sq_fading), vs 0.04 in the paper text.
Two-digit img_scale (code) vs the paper text's 'most significant digit'.
Visibility from gsplat (opacity<1/255 culled, opacity-aware radii, near 0.01) vs diff-gauss radii>0. Not yet listed.
Torch implementation of the fused kernel: same float32 formula, no speed claim.
summary: The optimizer and density code follow the official repository closely. adam.cu numerics, per-primitive asystep, DAR windows/λ/cap/img_scale, RSR (all six optimizers, α1 0.2 / code-effective α2 0.01, uniform without replacement over all current primitives, milestones), MCMC noise, clone opacity correction, 3DGS ADC, and zero child moments with inherited asystep all match. Installation into the runtime works: the in-place dict swap is stepped every iteration with the sparse visibility, the means LR schedule reaches it, and checkpoints work. Neither major issue is in the optimizer or density code; both concern which paper row is targeted. paper_results mixes the GS8 headline average with GS9 per-scene rows, and the headline GS8 outdoor configuration (released outdoor config + opacity reset 3000 + big prune) is not packaged. Recommended targets: bicycle = new 'adamw-gs-gs8' (GS8: 25.454 / 0.778 / 0.219, +0.216 over GS1 25.238, N_a 2.717M), with 'adamw-gs' (GS9 25.481, +0.243) as the released-config secondary; counter = 'adamw-gs-indoor' (GS7/GS8: 29.112 / 0.907 / 0.206, +0.066 over GS1 29.046, N_a 0.535M vs 1.092M).
